verdict.rationale: Skyvern is open-source (AGPL) and can be self-hosted entirely on your own infrastructure with your own LLM keys, which gives a credible exit path. A REST API and per-run artifacts (recordings, screenshots, reasoning, network traffic) suggest run data is retrievable, but nothing documents exporting all account data or workflow definitions from the cloud in open formats. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of cloud account data and workflows, specified open export formats, a cloud-to-self-hosted migration path, and independent corroboration of a successful export.
